title: Deliverables, MAP & Handoff
body: The Blueprint deliverable set, recap communications, Mutual Action Plan, success plan, and handoff to delivery, services and customer success
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Build a MAP and success plan from Blueprint outputs.
Hand off value commitments so they can be measured after go-live.
Attach partner services to the prioritized roadmap.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-110. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
